name: Marketstack
tagline: Real-time, intraday, and historical stock market data API for global exchanges.
description: Marketstack is a RESTful JSON API for stock market data, covering real-time, intraday, and end-of-day historical prices across tens of thousands of tickers and 70+ global exchanges. Powered by apilayer, it exposes endpoints for EOD data, tickers, exchanges, splits, dividends, and related metadata. Developers authenticate with a free or paid API access key and call HTTPS GET endpoints under api.marketstack.com.

auth.details: API access key passed as the access_key query parameter on every request; self-serve free signup at marketstack.com/signup/free.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month; end-of-day data only; up to 1 year of history (Free plan).
pricing.paid_plans: Basic ~10,000 req/mo; Professional ~100,000 req/mo; Business higher tiers; custom enterprise available (see pricing page for current USD).

rate_limits: Plan monthly request quotas (e.g. Free 100/mo, Basic 10,000/mo, Professional 100,000/mo); per-second/minute burst limits not clearly published on pricing.
use_cases: get latest end-of-day OHLCV for one or more stock symbols
fetch historical EOD prices for a ticker over a date range
list stock tickers and exchange metadata
retrieve stock splits and dividend history for a symbol
look up exchange trading hours, currencies, and timezones
